name: Taiwan NDF Investment Review
description: Taiwan National Development Fund and VC/PE investment review for valuation, EPS, dilution, use of funds, milestones, due diligence, investment-committee questions, and IPO/OTC listing readiness.
use_when: The user asks to review an investment proposal from a Taiwan NDF, VC, or PE perspective.
The task involves valuation, EPS, ownership, dilution, use-of-funds, forecast credibility, investment committee questions, or listing readiness.
The user needs to determine which National Development Fund investment route may fit a company or financing plan.
avoid_when: The task only asks for general personal investing or public-stock portfolio advice.
The task is only accounting bookkeeping and does not involve an investment transaction or financing review.
routing_hint: Use this skill for Taiwan NDF applications and institutional startup/growth-company investment reviews. Verify current NDF, TWSE, and TPEx rules from official sources when eligibility or listing requirements materially affect the answer.
